games.name: Chaos Central
games.desc:
add to the chaos... survive the chaos... die the chaos... :(

an increasingly chaotic bullet-hell type game where you survive levels of attacks, choosing new hazards to add to the mix as you go, until you simply cannot go any further.
manage points to afford upgrades efficiently and to better prepare yourself for what's to come...

⚠️chaos central is HARD and the difficulty curve is steep for new players, but the more you try, the more you can familiarize yourself with each individual hazard, making it smoother to play. don’t give up!!
⚠️this game has a lot of flashing lights and intense visuals!!

chaos central is actively under development and some bugfixes/changes may be getting tested in public servers. if something's off or shouldn't be there, that's probably why!

inspired by every (minigames) end and nullscape, among other things.

games.name: [UPDATE!] Madness: Project Nevada Remastered
games.desc:
Project Nevada Remastered is a difficult PVP game, it is expected to constantly die.

Use codes: MiniUpdateRelease!, 3MIL!, SRRYFORDELAY! FOR INGAME REWARDS

The year is 2008. The sun is pale as always, the rents due, weapons are cheap, but most of all; today's garbage day, and you've got a lot of trash to take out.

Project Nevada Remastered is an open-ended game set in the Madness Combat universe about doing whatever you want, and how you please. Go around doing contracts for cash, be a general nuisance for nothing but kicks, be a janitor if you so desire. Become a respected SNPD officer you've always wanted to become or be the vigilante protagonist your ego always told you that you were.

CONTROLS:
-CTRL = Run
-F = Block
-R = Heavy attack
-Q = Dash

 
Make sure to join our communication server in order to not miss out on potential updates and keep track of Project Nevada's news!
